description:
Women often see their hair as a reflection of their identity. Its a representation of their own style and personality. For some women a ‘bad hair day’ equals a bad day. Hair is more than whats on your head and makes a difference to the way many women feel about themselves.

Diamond diva hair aims to be part of your ‘good hair day’ experience  with our hair extensions, carefully selected ensure our clientele receive a high quality product. At diamond diva hair we aim to provide hair at an affordable price whilst still maintaining the quality. Our hair extensions  are 100% virgin hair and have not been chemically processed or styled. They can be dyed and bleached and the hair remains smooth and silky with good lustre, it also does not tangle and there is minimal shedding.

We also offer wig construction services, our wigs are handmade and customised to allow clients to have a product that is tailor made for them at the click of a button.
